cadenas.en_por_celda: Annual extinguisher maintenance by a licensed fire protection company: new tag and record (OSHA 1910.157); hood fire suppression inspected every 6 months (NFPA 96); hydrostatic tests as the label says (OSHA 1910.157(f))

cadenas.es: Revisión periódica de la instalación de gas por empresa habilitada, si el local tiene gas
cadenas.en_por_celda: Gas lines and appliance connections (griddle, range, oven, fryer) checked by a licensed pro, as often as your local code requires

cadenas.es: Prevención de legionela si hay agua caliente sanitaria de riesgo o torre de refrigeración

cadenas.es: Revisión de cámaras y abatidor por frigorista: estanqueidad, juntas y gas refrigerante
cadenas.en_por_celda: Refrigeration service by an EPA 608-certified tech: walk-in, reach-ins, prep-table coolers and the blast chiller if you have one — coils, gaskets and refrigerant leak check

cadenas.en_por_celda: Cardboard and plastic packaging pickup by your waste and recycling hauler: contract current and receipts filed (a ghost kitchen goes through far more packaging than a regular restaurant)

cadenas.es: Calibrar los termómetros y las sondas contra un patrón conocido (agua con hielo, 0 °C)
cadenas.en_por_celda: Calibrate thermometers and probes against a known reference (ice-point method, 32 °F)

cadenas.en_por_celda: Review insurance: general liability with products coverage (the food is eaten off-site), property and workers' comp, plus renewal dates

cadenas.es: Revisar los contratos y las comisiones de cada plataforma y el software de facturación (requisitos antifraude / Verifactu)
cadenas.en_por_celda: Review each delivery app's contract and commission plan, plus your POS and sales tax settings: who collects and remits the sales tax on app orders depends on your state's marketplace facilitator rules
